collection.description: A quiet boy has a useful idea at a flood meeting but keeps being interrupted.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A boy rarely speaks at meetings. During a flood discussion, he has a useful suggestion but keeps being interrupted.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: He prefers helping with preparations rather than public debate, and does so brilliantly.

a__fx.text: He proposes marking safe high ground; the village adopts the idea.
